decisions_made.decision: Server Component Architecture for Next.js App Router
decisions_made.reason: Social media web crawlers (Facebook External Hit, ZaloBot, TelegramBot) do not execute client-side JavaScript. Separating page.tsx into a Server Component allows generating real HTML <meta property='og:*'> tags.

decisions_made.decision: Dynamic Image Generation via next/og Edge Runtime
decisions_made.reason: Allows rendering ultra-crisp 1200x630 pixel Open Graph preview images with the recipient's name dynamically without needing third-party image generation APIs.
Ensures a warm, elegant, and personal tone across both direct view and social media link previews.
